reduction.irqMeasurementBoundary: Two epoch summaries: count u16, total CIA counts u32, maximum u16. Only declared cohorts are enabled. Interval is between coherent CIA reads after register preservation and before restoration; includes part of probes, excludes hardware entry and tails. Not full interrupt cost or entry latency. Bounded-read, count, total and duration overflow invalidate acquisition.

reduction.servicePhaseBoundary: Pre-release starts only; sixteen balanced nominal-period bins and six completed service orders per epoch. Aggregate masks do not prove every relative phase combination or external input/audio latency.
